identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase I Study of CRISPR-Cas9 Mediated PD-1 Gene-knocked Out Mesothelin-directed CAR-T Cells With the Conditioning Regimen of Paclitaxel and Cyclophosphamide in Mesothelin Positive Multiple Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
1. To evaluate the feasibility and safety of CRISPR-Cas9 mediated PD-1 gene-knocked out chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells in patients with mesothelin positive multiple solid tumors.
2. To evaluate the duration and in vivo persistence of transferred CAR-T cells.
3. To observe and measure anti-tumor responses for patients with detectable mesothelin positive tumor lesions.

primaryOutcomes.description: Grade 3 or severer signs/symptoms, toxicities and clinical

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Clinical responses of mesothelin-directed CAR T cells infusion
